name: GutVaidya Diet Powder
short_description: Contains handpicked traditional grains, millets, nuts, and natural herbs for daily immunity, gut health, and steady energy levels.
description: GutVaidya Diet Powder is crafted with over 36 sprouted grains, ancient millets, organic nuts, and sacred Ayurvedic herbs. Prepared following centuries-old tradition, this nutrient-dense mix is easy to digest, supports gut microbiome balance, soothes acidity, and provides sustained natural energy for the entire family without any artificial sweeteners or chemical preservatives.
ingredients: Sprouted Ragi, Foxtail Millet, Little Millet, Kodo Millet, Barnyard Millet, Sprouted Green Gram, Almonds, Walnuts, Pistachios, Cardamom, Dry Ginger, Shatavari, Licorice, Ashwagandha.
usage_instructions: Add 1 scoop (25g) into 400ml water or milk in a pan. Simmer on a low flame for 2 minutes while stirring continuously to prevent lumps. Add jaggery, honey, or salt as per taste, and enjoy comfortably warm.
